description: List the reviews (default) or the statements the user wrote on their own Parfumo account, newest first, with the perfume `id`, the full text, the ratings shown with it and the number of awards and comments. Returns a paginated list. Requires a linked Parfumo account.

oneOf.description: Statement: short review of 140 characters at most.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor: the `next_cursor` of the previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 25, maximum 100).

name: parfumo_list_my_reviews

MemberRatings.description: Ratings a member attached to a review or statement.

OwnText.description: A review or statement of the member, as listed on their own pages.

date.description: Age as shown by the site (reviews only, relative).

id.description: Numeric id of the review or statement.

perfume_id.description: Perfume identifier usable with every perfume tool (`Brand/Perfume`).

ratings.description: Ratings shown next to a review (0-10).

url.description: Parfumo URL of the review or statement.

oneOf.description: Statement: short review of 140 characters at most.

items.description: The member's own reviews or statements, newest first.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the following items. Absent when there is nothing more.

total_items.description: Number of reviews or statements, when the site states it.
